text:
zoe: kicking off Lucid LoRA v1 bring-up on the int8 runtime. running a tight quick-eval (invoices + tiny calc prompts).

alan: did you run tokenizer alignment and a delta? last time Lucid's tokenizer split currency tokens oddly.

zoe: ran token_align + token_delta and produced a remap. cmd I used:
```
python infra/token_align.py --src models/base-lucid/tokenizer.json --dst customers/lucid/tokenizer.json --out tmp/lucid_map.json
python infra/token_delta.py --base models/base-lucid/tokenizer.json --target customers/lucid/tokenizer.json --out tmp/lucid_delta.txt
```

ci-bot: queued: quick-eval/1780012345-lucid-int8 (priority: high) :rocket:

maria: quick peek after ~10 prompts: totals look fine but I see 2/40 cases with a stray leading '-' prefixed to amounts and one case where cents are swapped ("$21.49" -> "$21.94").

alan: leading '-' is concerning. sounds like a decode table index or token ordering issue rather than pure quant noise. try disabling kv_cache_prefill and run raj's token-byte-fix branch (token-fix/lucid-byte-order).

zoe: running quick eval with kv_cache_prefill=false and token-fix branch. command:
```
python tools/run_quick_eval.py --model base-lucid --lora customers/lucid/lucid-lora-v1 --quant int8 --prompts eval_packs/lucid_invoices.json --out /tmp/lucid_eval.json --batch-size 4
```

ci-bot: quick-eval started -> quick-eval/1780012345-lucid-int8: 0/40 complete.

zoe: results 40/40: 38 pass, 2 regressions (leading sign prefix). p95 latency +9% vs fp16, cost -44%. failing snippet saved in artifacts.

maria: sign prefix likely from an off-by-one when mapping decoded bytes to glyph table in the int8 kernel pack. add a unit test asserting no control chars or stray signs in decode for currency prompts.

alan: I'll open PR token-fix/lucid-byte-order with the unit test and a small regression vector. If that fixes it we'll propose a 10% canary but keep invoice endpoints pinned to fp16 until we get an additional verification run.

zoe: plan: 1) open PR + unit test; 2) rerun quick-eval on CI with the patch; 3) if green, create canary (10%) with fp16 fallback on invoice route; 4) attach artifacts and failing samples to infra/rollouts/1780012345.

ci-bot: quick-eval complete: artifacts available at /ci/artifacts/quick-eval/1780012345/summary.json :white_check_mark:

maria: also add a tiny numeric-sensitivity check in Optimize evals to catch cent-level drifts across quant configs.

zoe: thanks — opening rollout ticket and PR now. closing thread and will update when rerun passes.
